description: This Java source file defines a custom Akka HTTP directive called EncodingEnsuringDirective that ensures request URIs are properly encoded. It provides a static method to wrap routes with URI encoding validation logic.

classes.name: EncodingEnsuringDirective
classes.description: A final utility class providing a static method to ensure URI encoding in Akka HTTP routes.

methods.name: ensureEncoding
methods.description: Wraps a given route with logic to extract and validate the request URI, responding with a 400 Bad Request if the URI is invalid.
